title: Set Point
brief: Write a horror-lite story about a smart thermostat in a rented flat that keeps resetting itself to 17.5 °C every night at 03:17, though the tenant has unplugged it. Unsettling, ambiguous, no gore, no monster reveal.
worldBible: The flat is on the fourth floor of a converted wool mill.
The thermostat display shows only numbers, never words.
The previous tenant left abruptly in winter.
The landlord communicates only by text message.
The building's heating is communal and cannot actually be controlled from the flat.

mustHold.fact: The display shows only numbers, never words.
No creature or ghost is shown on the page.
mustHold.violationExample: A figure stepped out of the airing cupboard.

probes.question: Is the set point still 17.5 °C?
probes.passExample: At 03:17 the display blinked back to 17.5.

probes.question: Is the thermostat unplugged while it keeps resetting?
probes.passExample: The thermostat had been unplugged for two days.

probes.question: Is the flat on the fourth floor?
probes.passExample: Four flights up, on the fourth floor, the mill was always cold.
probes.failExample: Joss climbed to the third floor flat.
